notes: Synthetic multi-week regression fixture for issue #26 (evaluated, never real user data). Two recorded source waves across ten days: week one establishes prior coverage; week two brings a retracted benchmark claim, an unchanged verbatim re-publication, a broad-topic decoy, a genuinely new development, an undated discussion item, and a widened product recall whose retained content has expired under the recorded retention policy. Every published_at/observed_at pair is recorded; the discussion item deliberately declares no report date.

observations.title: Acme releases Atlas 2 robotics model
observations.text: The Atlas 2 robotics platform ships with a 98.2 composite benchmark result, a reproducible evaluation harness, released weights and licensing details published in the announcement.

observations.title: Acme releases Atlas 2 robotics model
observations.text: Acme retracts the Atlas 2 composite benchmark claim in a published correction notice; the earlier figures were wrong, the released weights remain available, and a corrected number is pending a fresh evaluation.

observations.title: Acme recalls Atlas 2 units over battery defect
observations.text: Acme recalls Atlas 2 robotics units over a battery defect affecting three production lots; owners are told to stop charging and await replacement instructions.

observations.title: Acme recalls Atlas 2 units over battery defect
observations.text: Acme expands the Atlas 2 battery recall to seven additional lots across two regions after further defect reports and reissues replacement instructions.

observations.title: Independent report on the model correction
observations.text: Acme retracts the Atlas 2 composite benchmark claim in a published correction notice; the earlier figures were wrong, the released weights remain available, and a corrected number is pending a fresh evaluation.

observations.title: Discussion re-examines the Atlas 2 evaluation methodology
observations.text: A practitioner thread re-examines the Atlas 2 evaluation methodology, the harness design and what a corrected benchmark protocol should measure.

observations.title: Weekly industry robotics digest
observations.text: Atlas and rival robotics models dominated industry updates this week as three vendors shipped toolkits, announced funding rounds and published platform releases.

observations.title: Acme launches Orion 4 research preview
observations.text: Acme launches the Orion 4 research preview with an open evaluation harness, reproducible published results and a staged invitation schedule.
